name: pi-recon
description: Pi extension for red-team recon and asset discovery. 14 tools: ICP lookup, subdomain enum, DNS/cert/ASN, asset search (Shodan/FOFA/Hunter/Quake), port scan, web probe, dir brute, backup finder, 403 bypass, vuln check, JS analysis.
